glyph_origin: Ideogram (指事): a man with a painted or tattooed chest – original form of 紋. The tattoo was usually a cross, a V shape or a stylized heart. In the current form, the tattoo has vanished, making it simply an outline of a man (head, outstretched arms, legs, chest) similar to 立. Compare 大, which has no chest. Unrelated to the Kangxi radicals 齐 and 攵.
